usdRate.sourceName: Banque Centrale de Mauritanie, daily reference exchange rates 2008-2025 (USD)
usdRate.note: Reference rate of 39.64 ouguiya per dollar on 19 December 2025, the last 2025 value in the BCM file; the 2025 average was 39.75. No 2026 file was reachable.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Banque Centrale de Mauritanie (BCM), daily key rates feed (taux d'inflation)
inflation_cpi.note: 9.3% as displayed by the BCM on 29 October 2026 (latest month not stated); consistent with the IMF WEO projection of 8.0% average and 9.0% end-2026 inflation, after 1.6% in 2025.

inflation_projection.note: No published inflation target; the 2021-2025 average (4.4%) and the IMF medium-term 4% are rounded to 4.5% given the 2026 spike.

policy_rate.sourceName: BCM daily key rates feed (taux directeur)
policy_rate.note: Policy rate 6.75%; overnight deposit facility 2%, repo (lending facility) 7%.

savings_account_rate.note: No published typical savings account rate was found; the BCM site is a JavaScript app with no rates table reachable, and web search was unavailable during this run.

fdr_3m_rate.note: No published 3-month term deposit rate was found on the BCM site.

fdr_1y_rate.note: No published 1-year term deposit rate was found on the BCM site.

dps_rate.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product or rate was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: World Bank WDI, deposit interest rate (FR.INR.DPST), Mauritania
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: 5.67% in 2017, the latest World Bank value (much older than 2025); no fresher BCM average deposit rate was found.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: BCM, Treasury securities auction rates (bons du Trésor 13 semaines)
tbill_91d_rate.note: 13-week Treasury bill rate 4.58% at the auction of 29 October 2026 (26-week 4.09%, 52-week 4.26%).

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: BCM, Treasury securities auction rates (obligations du Trésor 5 ans)
tbond_5y_rate.note: 5-year Treasury bond rate 4.82% as of 29 October 2026.

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: BCM, Treasury securities auction rates (obligations du Trésor 10 ans)
tbond_10y_rate.note: 10-year Treasury bond rate 4.30% as of 29 October 2026 (15-year 5.99%).

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Mauritania, individual income determination
tax_bank_interest.note: Interest on deposits with a Mauritanian bank is taxed at 10%, withheld by the bank (secondary source).

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate exists for individuals, so no tax rule for one was found; bond interest is taxed at 10% (PwC).

deposit_insurance_limit.note: No deposit guarantee cover limit per depositor was found from the BCM.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or typical credit card rate was found.

equity_return_low.sourceName: No stock exchange in Mauritania; global equities in ouguiya terms
equity_return_low.note: No local stock market exists, so equity means a global index in ouguiya terms; low case is a weak decade for global shares.

equity_return_base.sourceName: No stock exchange in Mauritania; global equities in ouguiya terms
equity_return_base.note: Global equities in ouguiya terms, held about 3.4 points above the 4.1% after-tax 13-week bill rate, since access is only through foreign funds.

equity_return_high.sourceName: No stock exchange in Mauritania; global equities in ouguiya terms
equity_return_high.note: High case: global equities repeat their long-run record plus mild ouguiya depreciation.

gold_return_low.sourceName: BCM ouguiya/dollar reference rates 2025 (about 39.6-39.8 per dollar); gold trend in dollars
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat gold prices and a stable ouguiya.

gold_return_base.sourceName: BCM ouguiya/dollar reference rates 2025 (about 39.6-39.8 per dollar); gold trend in dollars
gold_return_base.note: Base case: the long-run dollar gold trend of about 5% plus about 1% a year of ouguiya depreciation.

gold_return_high.sourceName: BCM ouguiya/dollar reference rates 2025 (about 39.6-39.8 per dollar); gold trend in dollars
gold_return_high.note: High case: strong gold years with faster depreciation.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: BCM Treasury auctions: 13-week bill 4.58% (29 Oct 2026); 10% tax on interest (PwC)
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: shorter bills or deposits after the 10% interest tax.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: BCM Treasury auctions: 13-week bill 4.58% (29 Oct 2026); 10% tax on interest (PwC)
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: the 13-week bill rate of 4.58% less 10% tax (4.1%), rounded down.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: BCM Treasury auctions: 13-week bill 4.58% (29 Oct 2026); 10% tax on interest (PwC)
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: longer Treasury bonds (5-year 4.82%, 15-year 5.99%) after tax.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No industry-wide life insurance claim settlement ratio was found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No published term life premium rates per MRU 1,000 of cover were found; the life insurance market is very small.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical out-of-pocket cost of a major hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premiums by age were found.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure), Mauritania
oop_health_share.note: 43.8% in 2023 (WHO Global Health Expenditure Database via the World Bank), the latest available; older than 2025.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Inflation assumption 4.5%; no medical CPI found
goal_inflation_health.note: No medical price index was found; medical costs, many imported, are planned 1.5 points above general inflation.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: Inflation assumption 4.5%; no education CPI found
goal_inflation_education.note: No education price index was found; private school costs are planned 1 point above general inflation.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN), Mauritania

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; totals are the mean of men and women except at 65, where the page gives 13.7 for both sexes.

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 5.97 (2025, World Bank), 6.6 (2040, populationpyramid.net/mauritania/2040/) and 10.4 (2065, populationpyramid.net/mauritania/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Caisse Nationale de Sécurité Sociale (CNSS), FAQ: conditions for an old-age pension
retirement_age_default.note: Old-age pension at 63 with at least 20 years of CNSS registration, 60 months of insurance in the last 10 years and stopping salaried work (CNSS site FAQ); no separate age for women is given.

retirement_age_government.note: The retirement age of civil servants (Caisse des Retraites de l'Etat) could not be confirmed from an official source during this run.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: BCM Treasury auctions: 13-week bill 4.58% (29 Oct 2026); 10% tax on interest (PwC)
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: deposits and short bills after tax.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: BCM Treasury auctions: 13-week bill 4.58% (29 Oct 2026); 10% tax on interest (PwC)
retirement_return_base.note: Base case: kept below the 4.1% after-tax 13-week bill rate.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: BCM Treasury auctions: 13-week bill 4.58% (29 Oct 2026); 10% tax on interest (PwC)
retirement_return_high.note: High case: a ladder of Treasury bonds after tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Safe rate 4.1% after tax; global equity base 7.5%; gold base 6%
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case: mostly deposits and bills.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Safe rate 4.1% after tax; global equity base 7.5%; gold base 6%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: bills and deposits with some gold and foreign equity funds.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Safe rate 4.1% after tax; global equity base 7.5%; gold base 6%
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case: a growth-leaning mix with foreign equity funds.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No non-contributory old-age pension was found; the national cash transfer programme targets poor households, not older people as such.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No non-contributory old-age pension rules were found.

gratuity_rule.note: The Labour Code provisions on dismissal or end-of-service indemnity could not be read from an official source during this run.

public_pension_scheme.note: The CNSS pays old-age pensions from 63 (see retirement_age_default), but its indexation, entry rules and tax treatment could not be confirmed from an official source.

savings_account.note: Banks offer savings accounts; interest is taxed at 10%.

fdr_3m.note: Banks take term deposits, but rates are not published.

fdr_1y.note: Banks take term deposits, but rates are not published.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product was found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate for individuals was found.

tbill_91d.note: 13-week bills are auctioned by the BCM; no retail subscription channel for individuals was found.

tbond_5y.note: Bonds are auctioned by the BCM; no retail subscription channel for individuals was found.

tbond_10y.note: Bonds are auctioned by the BCM; no retail subscription channel for individuals was found.

equity_fund.note: There is no stock exchange in Mauritania and no locally sold equity fund was found.

gold.note: Gold is mined in Mauritania and sold mainly as jewellery; the BCM buys artisanal gold.

publicHealthCover.name: Caisse Nationale d'Assurance Maladie (CNAM)
publicHealthCover.note: Health insurance for insured workers and their dependants.

statistics.name: Agence Nationale de la Statistique et de la Démographie (ANSADE)
